## Symbols in words

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $y(t)$, $B(t)$ | biomass on day $t$ (t/ha) |
| $L(t)$ | leaf area index |
| $u_t$ | the weather drivers on day $t$: TT, DL, RAW, RAD, standardised |
| $\theta_j(u)$ | one candidate function in the library (for example $\text{TT}^2$) |
| $\Theta$ | the library: the value of every candidate on every day |
| $\xi$ | coefficients, one per library term |
| $\mu$, $\delta_g$ | shared coefficients, and the deviation of genotype $g$ |
| $A = X^\top X$, $b = X^\top z$ | normal-equation statistics: all a linear fit needs |
| $k$ | number of terms kept by the sparse fit |

## Function index

All functions are in `R/functions.R` and use base R only. Each page shows the code of the functions it uses.

| Function | Step | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `make_drivers(wx)` | 3 | standardised weather array `[year, day, driver]` |
| `make_library(drv, degree, pairs)` | 3 | library array `[year, day, term]` |
| `make_trajectories(traj, drv, var)` | 3 | response array `[genotype, year, day]` |
| `build_design(Theta, tr, genotypes)` | 3 | explicit design matrix `X` and response `z` |
| `gram_stats(Theta, tr)` | 3 | `A` and `b` per genotype and year |
| `fit_ols`, `fit_ridge`, `fit_ssr` | 4 | fitting methods with signature `fit(A, b, ...)` |
| `fit_hier`, `fit_years` | 4, 7 | shared coefficients plus genotype deviations |
| `simulate(xi, Theta_y, y0)` | 5 | roll the equation forward (running total) |
| `cv_blocked(...)` | 5 | leave-one-year-out cross-validation |
| `evaluate(P, tr)` | 5 | trajectory, fixed-day and maturity RMSE |
| `ale_curve(rate, Z, j)` | 6 | accumulated local effect of driver `j` |
| `rank_scores`, `lookup_baseline` | 7 | ranking metrics and the no-weather baseline |

## Data

Daily simulated wheat growth from the APSIM model at Narrabri (NSW, Australia): 199 genotypes, 31 seasons (1983 to 2013). See [Data](02-data.qmd) for the columns. Files are in `data/`.

The data are simulation output. The source and licence of the underlying APSIM simulations should be confirmed before reuse or redistribution; this repository grants no licence for them.

- Apley, D. W. and Zhu, J. (2020). Visualizing the effects of predictor variables in black box supervised learning models. *Journal of the Royal Statistical Society B* 82(4), 1059–1086.
